allow: git status, git diff, git log, git fetch, git show in any registered repo — read-only, no mutation, always allow
nix flake check — dry validation only, no system mutation, always allow
nixos-rebuild dry-activate — preview/build only, does not switch the running system, always allow
nixos-rebuild list-generations, readlink /run/current-system — read-only inspection of already-applied generations, always allow
ssh to the registry-resolved tgw-prod host for read-only diagnostics (journalctl, systemctl status, git status/diff/log, D-Bus property/method reads, ps) — no retired or unregistered host names
